headlines.title: The rise and fall of former Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang
headlines.description: Jensen Huang, who once led the most valuable company in the world, resigned from his post as Nvidia CEO today after an affair with a suspected Chinese spy. Huang had co-founded Nvidia in 1993, and it became a juggernaut making the chips underpinning much of the AI boom.

headlines.title: Trump recommends Tim Cook for Nvidia CEO after Jensen Huang resigns
headlines.description: President Trump weighed in on the search for a permanent CEO shortly after Nvidia’s announcement about Jensen Huang's resignation, saying that Apple executive chair Tim Cook should take the role. NBC News' Allie Canal and New York Times contributor Don Clark discuss Cook's industry experience and the background of interim CEO Colette Kress.

headlines.title: Who is Colette Kress, Nvidia’s new interim CEO?
headlines.description: For 13 years, Colette Kress helped manage the company’s transformation from a graphics-chip maker into the company at the center of the AI boom.

headlines.title: D.C. gunman kills condo manager at gym then opens fire on pedestrians
headlines.description: An emergency room doctor killed his condo building manager before opening fire on pedestrians from his balcony, according to police. NBC News’ Ryan Nobles reports.

headlines.title: Ring camera video shows the moment of Brooklyn building collapse
headlines.description: Ring camera video shows the moment of the deadly building collapse in the Flatbush area of Brooklyn, New York. At least eight people are dead following the collapse, with search and rescue teams continuing operations around the clock in the hope of finding more survivors.

headlines.title: Democrat Cindy Holscher defeats Republican Ty Masterson in Kansas governor’s race
headlines.description: Democratic state Sen. Cindy Holscher has narrowly won Kansas’ race for governor, NBC News projected Thursday, extending the party’s hold on the office in the red state.

headlines.title: Widespread outage hits Microsoft platforms including Outlook, thousands report issues
headlines.description: A widespread outage hit Microsoft platforms including Outlook, with many users encountering trouble using their email accounts and other errors across the tech giant’s suite of apps. NBC News' Marquise Francis reports on why this error is occurring.

headlines.title: She’s delivered 2,000 babies. The measles outbreak changed her mind about vaccines.
headlines.description: Traditional midwives like Roberta Devers could be key to increasing vaccination as outbreaks spread in rural communities such as those in Pennsylvania.

headlines.title: What are childhood vaccination rates in your community and schools?
headlines.description: This is part of The Vaccine Divide, an updated data investigation into America potentially losing its measles-free status as the deadly virus roars back and childhood vaccine defenses continue to crack and crumble.

headlines.title: Behind the data: How NBC News tracked the decline in childhood vaccinations
headlines.description: How an NBC News data investigation tracked vaccination and school exemption rates across thousands of counties in the U.S.

headlines.title: Measles cases explode amid declining vaccination rates
headlines.description: NBC News’ Erin McLaughlin traveled to Lancaster County, Pennsylvania, which is the epicenter of a deadly measles outbreak. The investigative report for the NBC News series “The Vaccine Divide” finds 75% of U.S. counties have vaccination rates that are now below the level needed for herd immunity.
